title: Lecture 01 - The Learning Problem
summary: The first lecture of Caltech's CS 156 Machine Learning course by Yaser Abu-Mostafa, introducing the learning problem and supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning. It is one of 18 lectures in the Learning from Data course.
why: Recommended repeatedly in 'where do I start with ML' threads as a clear, math-aware introduction.

quote.text: I have found the Caltech machine learning intro course to be the most elucidating of any resource so far
